name: clamp the slopes at the knots so every piece stays monotone
mechanism: estimate a slope at each knot from its neighbours, then limit each slope (to zero at local extremes, and to a bound from the adjacent secants elsewhere) so that no cubic piece can overshoot between two increasing or two decreasing samples

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Monotone cubic interpolation' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Interpolation and extrapolation: a variant of cubic interpolation that preserves monotonicity of the data set being interpolated.

fails_when: loses one order of accuracy where slopes are clamped
